firstPartyEvidence.finding: Porsche Destination Charging is free for Porsche customers staying at partner establishments; non-Porsche users may be charged depending on establishment policy.

Porsche Charging Service publishes contractual/eMSP France prices and lists Porsche Sales & Marketplace among Preferred partners; these are charging-service prices, not proof of a universal direct CPO price.
Porsche Charging Service is a multi-network service with subscription/contract tariffs; partner charging infrastructure settles through Porsche's service.

currentEstateObservation: Current France inventory includes both Porsche Centre / Sales & Marketplace stations and Porsche Destination Charging partner venues, so one direct tariff cannot safely cover all historical sites.
conclusion: No universal direct CPO tariff. Direct price/access varies by site/eligibility; Porsche Charging Service pricing is roaming/eMSP and excluded from CPO-direct authority.
reopenCondition: Deterministic station/EVSE mapping to a first-party direct host/Porsche CPO tariff, exact QR/ad-hoc payload, or authoritative AFIR/QualiCharge direct tariff per EVSE.
